# TASK-171 — Fixes for the review's Critical and High findings and the small Medium ones

- **Status:** Done — implemented and verified
- **Area:** UX review against Apple's Human Interface Guidelines (2026-10-09)

## Intent

Fixes for the review's Critical and High findings and the small Medium ones: control edges at 3:1 or more (`--control-line`), Increase Contrast support (`prefers-contrast: more`), light and dark following the system by default and live (`appearance.ts`, "Match system"), phone frame reduced (Dashboard, Settings and account in the Views menu, no breadcrumb row; the title starts about 110 px higher), no text below 0.75rem in the rail badge and section dots, `--nav-muted` at 4.8:1 on hover, and one primary action under Readiness.

## What it delivers

Tests: `appearance.test.tsx` (3), `readiness.test.tsx`, the UX tour (axe, targets, no sideways scrolling), contrast script (no failures in light or dark).
